name: Quality cupping lab
description: Equipped a cupping lab so the cooperative can sort lots by quality and negotiate higher prices for specialty coffee.
reason: Low farm-gate prices for undifferentiated coffee.

name: Youth agricultural training
description: Training program for young people in banana farm management to reduce youth migration.
reason: Young people migrating for lack of local work.

name: Organic fertilizer plant
description: Set up a compost and bio-fertilizer production unit so members can restore soil organic matter on depleted coffee plots.
reason: Declining soil fertility and rising fertilizer costs.

name: Forest boundary protection
description: Trained community members to monitor the forest reserve boundary and restore degraded areas with native species.
reason: Encroachment of cocoa farms into the forest reserve.

name: Revolving credit fund
description: Created a revolving credit fund so members can cover harvest costs without selling early to intermediaries at low prices.
reason: Members forced to sell early at low prices to cover harvest costs.

name: Erosion control terraces
description: Built live barriers and terraces on steep coffee plots to reduce soil erosion during heavy rain.
reason: Soil loss on steep slopes.

name: Worker housing improvements
description: Improved housing and sanitation for seasonal workers to retain labor during harvest.
reason: Workers migrating to cities and abroad, causing labor shortages at harvest.

subcategory: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
name: Cocoa agroforestry
description: Distributed native forest tree seedlings to plant in cocoa farms and mapped plots to avoid deforestation.
reason: Deforestation pressure and declining rainfall in cocoa areas.

subcategory: Waste management (Trash collection, recycling facilities etc.)
name: Wet-mill wastewater treatment
description: Built a treatment system for coffee wet-mill wastewater (aguas mieles) before discharge to the river.
reason: River contamination from processing wastewater.

subcategory: Climate Change Mitigation/Adaptation (Clean Energy, Agroforestry etc.)
name: Shade trees for moisture retention
description: Planted native shade trees and mulched coffee plots to keep soil moisture during longer dry spells.
reason: Longer dry periods and higher temperatures stressing coffee plants.

name: Rust monitoring follow-up
description: Follow-up visits to renovated plots. Contact Ing. Rosa Huaman at +51 976 555 210 for the schedule.
reason: Coffee leaf rust.

name: Rainwater reservoirs
description: Built rainwater harvesting reservoirs and drip irrigation for member plots after two dry seasons reduced coffee yields.
reason: Unreliable rainfall and water shortages during flowering.

name: Drip irrigation phase 2
description: Extend drip irrigation to the remaining member plots.
reason: Continued dry seasons.

name: Coffee pulp composting
description: Composted coffee pulp from the mill and returned it to member farms as fertilizer.
reason: Pulp piles polluting nearby streams.

subcategory: Human resources and administration/ office services
name: Childcare center for workers
description: Opened a childcare center so worker families, especially women, can keep working on the farm.
reason: Women workers leaving because there is no childcare.

name: Water recirculation in pulping
description: Installed water recirculation in the pulping line to cut water use per kilo of coffee processed.
reason: Water scarcity at the mill during the dry season.

name: Community water tanks
description: Installed shared water storage tanks and repaired spring catchments serving 120 member households.
reason: Springs drying up in the dry season.

name: Honey and allspice diversification
description: Supported members to add beekeeping and allspice as second income sources alongside coffee.
reason: Falling coffee prices and unstable income.

name: Cocoa pod husk composting
description: Turned cocoa pod husks into compost instead of leaving them to rot, reducing black pod disease and improving soil.
reason: Black pod disease and poor soil fertility.

name: Coffee rust management program
description: Renovated plots with rust-resistant varieties and trained members in integrated pest management.
reason: Coffee leaf rust outbreaks after wetter seasons.
